import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse.linalg import LinearOperator, eigsh

# Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(counts, np.ndarray):
        raise TypeError("counts must be a numpy array")
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all():
        raise ValueError("counts contains nonfinite values")
    if np.any(counts < 0):
        raise ValueError("counts contains negative values")
    if counts.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("counts must be 2D")
    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape
    if np.any(np.all(counts == 0, axis=1)):
        raise ValueError("counts contains all-zero rows")
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be 1 <= n_components < n_cells")

    # Define matrix-free operator for Gram matrix A = counts @ counts.T
    def matvec(v):
        # v is 1-D array of length n_cells
        return counts @ (counts.T @ v)

    A = LinearOperator((n_cells, n_cells), matvec=matvec, dtype=counts.dtype)

    # Reproducible initialization
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    v0 = rng.randn(n_cells)

    # Compute leading eigenvalues and eigenvectors
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(A, k=n_components, which='LM', v0=v0)

    # Sort descending
    idx = np.argsort(eigenvalues)[::-1]
    eigenvalues_desc = eigenvalues[idx]
    eigenvectors_desc = eigenvectors[:, idx]

    return eigenvalues_desc, eigenvectors_desc
